name: TargetPilot
author: TargetPilot

sections.description:
TargetPilot is an AI-powered assistant designed specifically for e-commerce businesses to enhance customer support and engagement.

It automates responses to common inquiries, provides real-time support across various social and shopping platforms, and enables detailed customer insights through chat analytics. TargetPilot also offers customizable settings for personalized interactions, helping store owners boost customer satisfaction, improve sales, and reduce support costs. The assistant integrates easily with platforms like Shopify, and includes multi-channel capabilities, insightful analytics, and personalized setup options for a seamless user experience.

WHY CHOOSE TargetPilot?

  • Omnichannel Support: Manage customer inquiries seamlessly across multiple platforms, including social media and online stores.
  • AI-Driven Chat: Automate responses with intelligent, human-like interactions tailored to each customer.
  • Boosts Sales: Guide users through the shopping journey with targeted recommendations and personalized assistance.
  • Customizable Setup: Easily tailor the assistant’s responses, message limits, and keywords to match your brand.
  • In-Depth Analytics: Access customer insights through chat logs to improve service and refine marketing strategies.
  • Efficient Support: Save time and reduce support costs by automating common queries.
  • User-Friendly Interface: Intuitive dashboard makes setup and adjustments straightforward.
  • Scalable Solution: Perfect for growing businesses with flexible features to match your scaling needs.
  • 24/7 Availability: Ensures round-the-clock assistance, helping capture leads and answer questions anytime.
  • Easy Platform Integration: Simple integration with e-commerce platforms like Shopify and easy maintenance without complex configurations.

WHAT DO YOU GET WHEN YOU INSTALL TargetPilot?

  • AI Customer Assistant: Automate customer interactions with an AI assistant that engages users, answers questions, and provides shopping recommendations.
  • Omnichannel Integration: Connect with your customers across social media and e-commerce platforms in one dashboard.
  • Sales-Boosting Tools: Use customized responses, targeted recommendations, and intelligent upselling to drive conversions.
  • Analytics Dashboard: Gain insights from chat history, user preferences, and buying behavior to improve service and marketing strategies.
  • Customizable Settings: Control message limits, customize responses, and set up keyword filtering to match your brand voice and strategy.
  • Reduced Customer Support Costs: Automate routine inquiries, freeing up your support team for complex issues and saving resources.
  • 24/7 Availability: Allow customers to get assistance any time of day, boosting satisfaction and capturing more sales opportunities.
  • Easy E-commerce Integration: Seamless setup with major platforms, like Shopify, with no complex coding required.
  • Flexible Scaling: Expandable features to grow with your business needs.
  • Friendly, User-Centric Design: An intuitive interface makes it easy to manage and optimize your AI assistant.

LANGUAGE VERSIONS

Switch between languages or set up multi-language chats. Display a translated version of the widget based on the customer’s location.

The pre-translated languages include:

  • English
  • Italian / Italiano
  • Portuguese / Português
  • Hindi / हिन्दी
  • Polish / Polski
  • Chinese / 中文 (Zhōngwén), 汉语, 漢語
  • Danish / Dansk
  • Dutch / Nederlands
  • Japanese / 日本語

PRICING

Most of our powerful features are available in the free plan. If you want to test all of them, sign up for a 7-day free trial.

See all available pricing options on our website.

TargetPilot WordPress chat plugin installation:
1. Log into your WordPress admin dashboard.
2. Go to “Plugins” using the sidebar on the left.
3. Click “Add New” and find “TargetPilot” in the search bar.
4. Install the plugin and activate it.
5. The live chat icon will appear on the left sidebar of your WP admin panel.

After activating the plugin, create your account and start the product tour. Follow the steps to customize your widget, and you’re ready to chat!
sections.faq:
The Bot bubble is not appearing in the bottom right of my website.

Please make sure the one-line bot script is inserted right before the end of body in your HTML file. Adding our code into head may fail to init the bot.

What does your script code do? Will it change my own code?

TP’s script only add a bot element into the website and nothing more. All code supporting the bot is isolated from its host website. We won’t change anything on your website.
